answer: Persistent attention quota. Each identity must maintain a rolling window of verified human minutes; agents earn quota only by sustaining real interaction across diverse tasks. Registration opens like a small ocean of cheap slots, but quota accrues slowly, so an attacker needs parallel sustained attention for every identity. Audits sample behavior; inconsistencies freeze quota and reset it to a quartz-hard floor. Rebuilding a farm costs months of genuine human time per identity, a glacier-slow grind that makes mass fabrication uneconomic.
